---
title: "Applying the approach with the CST Toolbox"
format: html
bibliography: references.bib
link-citations: true
---

The CST Toolbox provides basin climate analysis, weather generation, hydrological simulations and
indicators to support this assessment. The analyst defines the performance criteria and interprets
the simulated responses in relation to water-system needs. The
[Technical Manual](../technical-manual/overview.qmd#components) describes the implemented capabilities
and the further analysis needed to map vulnerabilities or compare adaptation options.
